trajectory_note: embedding_effective_rank falls monotonically and severely from B0's 17.48 to 2.96 (epoch1, the checkpoint actually SELECTED and used for every downstream evaluation below) to 1.89 (epoch3) to 1.49 (epoch6) -- collapse is already present after a single epoch and keeps deepening for as long as training continues, never stabilising or reversing within the 6 epochs trained. pairwise_cosine_mean rises from B0's 0.474 (candidates well-separated) to 0.99+ at epoch1/3 (candidates nearly indistinguishable), then partially relaxes to 0.915 at epoch6 with a much larger std (0.139 vs 0.016 at epoch3) -- consistent with the embeddings settling into a still-tiny but slightly less uniform low-dimensional subspace, not a recovery of the original representation's spread.

drift_probe_from_training_log.note: separate fixed 256-row probe computed DURING training (results/EXP-ENCODER-UNFREEZE01/encoder_drift.csv), reporting L2 drift and cosine-to-B0 per epoch -- both grow monotonically (drift_l2 0.826->0.931, cosine_to_b0 0.650->0.559 from epoch1 to epoch6), corroborating the embedding_geometry trajectory above: the representation moves steadily further from B0 for as long as training continues, with no sign of settling.
